title: Rakul Singh (@rakulpreet) • Instagram photos and videos
meta_description:
24M Followers, 580 Following, 2,562 Posts - Rakul Singh (@rakulpreet) on Instagram: "Throw happiness around like a confetti 🎉
Co founder @newkind.in @arambamofficial"

posts.meta_description:
255K likes, 1,362 comments - rakulpreet on October 20, 2026: "There’s truly nobody like you, Telugu audience! ❤️✨

It’s been a while since I got to be amongst you, promoting a film, and last night reminded me just how much I’ve missed this! The warmth, the love, the energy, and the way you cheer with all your heart for cinema you made the evening so special for all of us at Team Ramayana. ❤️‍🔥

Last night was nothing short of magical, and honestly, those cheers are still ringing in my ears! Taking back so much love and that incredible adrenaline rush with me. ❤️

Here’s a little glimpse of me stepping into Suparnakha’s world in Ramayana and bringing a little bit of her magic to you. ✨✨".

32K likes, 189 comments - rakulpreet on October 19, 2026: "Happy Birthday, Mom! ❤️

You have a way of making people feel loved without even trying, and that’s such a beautiful thing about you. I hope today brings you as much happiness as you bring to everyone around you. Wishing you endless reasons to smile, lots of love, good health, and a year filled with beautiful moments.

Lots and lots of love to you! ❤️🤗".

34K likes, 304 comments - rakulpreet on October 16, 2026: "This Diwali, I’m choosing comfort that keeps up with every celebration! ✨🪔💃🏻
From dancing like there’s no tomorrow and clicking a million pictures to exchanging gifts, whether I’m lounging on the sofa or sitting on the floor, I am in my festive beauties from @Bata.india❤️✨
So this festive season, I’m all about sparkling looks, happy feet, and dancing till 5 AM! 💃🏻".

77K likes, 332 comments - rakulpreet on September 17, 2026: "A little escape from the usual, and exactly the kind of break I needed. ✨

Beautiful views, amazing food, slow mornings, good conversations and so many little moments that made the stay special. From the comfort of the property to simply enjoying the surroundings, everything felt like a reminder to pause, unwind and be present.

Some getaways are about the destination, and some are simply about how the place makes you feel. 🤍

@myconiancollectionhotel @nijhawan.representation @royalmyconian".
